# Dashboard Tools

> A toolkit and playbook that lets an AI model design and build a polished, custom business dashboard: an onboarding interview, business-type recipes, a design rulebook, design tokens with 10 themes, 38 reference dashboards, a tool and skill catalog, and a step-by-step build process.

If a person asked you to build a dashboard and gave you this repository, read START.md first and follow it. Ask the intake questions before you build anything. All paths below are raw files you can fetch.

## Start here (read in this order)

- [START.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/START.md): entry point: how to operate, what to read, the five-step flow, rules, definition of done
- [Intake interview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/onboarding/01-intake.md): three short rounds of questions with defaults
- [Recipes by business type](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/onboarding/recipes.md): pages, records, numbers, steps and looks to propose ([JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/catalog/recipes.json))
- [Brief template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/templates/brief.md): the one page the person approves
- [Build playbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/onboarding/02-build-playbook.md): prototype first, then the working app; polish and delivery
- [Design rulebook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/design/02-rulebook.md): hard rules for spacing, type, color, motion, states, copy
- [When you don't know how](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/onboarding/03-when-you-dont-know.md): lookup order: this repo, quickref.me (syntax), learn-anything.xyz (topics), library docs, the person
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/AGENTS.md): ground rules, definition of done, what is always wrong

## Design system

- [Tokens and themes (CSS)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/design-system/tokens.css): every color, space, radius, shadow, font and duration; 10 themes
- [Theme metadata](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/design-system/themes.json)
- [Page patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/design/03-page-patterns.md): List, Detail, Board, Dashboard, Form, Settings and their rules
- [Data visualization](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/design/04-data-viz.md)
- [Anti-patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/design/05-anti-patterns.md)
- [Polish standard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/design/08-polish-standard.md) · [Motion system](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/design/09-motion-system.md) · [Materials](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/design/10-materials.md) · [Hero art direction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/design/11-hero-art-direction.md) · [Microinteractions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/design/12-microinteractions.md) · [High-end checklist](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/design/13-high-end-checklist.md)

## Reference dashboards (pick the look)

- [Gallery guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/dashboards/README.md)
- [Gallery catalog (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/catalog/dashboards.json): 38 dashboards with style family, use cases, palette, layout, mood, best for, avoid when
- [Gallery catalog (readable)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/dashboards/catalog.md)
- [Reference-twin playbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/dashboards/02-reference-twin-playbook.md): how to build a high-end dashboard that matches a look: scaling frame, poured and scooped shapes, layered glass, live 3D hero, pages in one frame, phone layout
- Worked example, photo frame with glass and organic shapes: [index.html](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/site/dashboards/haven-listings/index.html) · [style.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/site/dashboards/haven-listings/style.css) · [app.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/site/dashboards/haven-listings/app.js)
- Worked example, flat board with a live 3D object: [index.html](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/site/dashboards/meridian-labs/index.html) · [style.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/site/dashboards/meridian-labs/style.css) · [app.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/site/dashboards/meridian-labs/app.js) · [helix.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/site/dashboards/meridian-labs/helix.js)
- [Style frameworks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/dashboards/05-style-frameworks.md): one recipe per look (glass, liquid glass, clay, soft-3D tiles, neumorphic, HUD, organic shapes, 3D object, ridges, CSS 3D, art, colour, type, motion); every dashboard keeps its own form
- [Verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/dashboards/06-verification.md): captures, gates, eleven questions, decision table, pre-publish list ([report template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/templates/polish-report.md))
- [Finishing pass](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/dashboards/04-finishing-pass.md): the look-then-fix pass after the checks pass: art in a box, stretched images, wrong charts, washed-out 3D, thin inner pages
- Worked example, scrolling page with a CSS 3D hero: [index.html](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/site/dashboards/tidebath-showroom/index.html) · [style.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/site/dashboards/tidebath-showroom/style.css) · [app.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/site/dashboards/tidebath-showroom/app.js)
- [Asset and tool map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/dashboards/03-asset-and-tool-map.md): outside tools for 3D, images, screenshots and motion, each with a fallback
- [Layout spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/dashboards/07-layout-spec.md): the reference layout as numbers the check measures
- [Elements and objects](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/dashboards/08-object-spec.md): guardrail layers, 3D object spec and build recipe, required tool routing
- Live preview of any dashboard: https://dashboard-tools-three.vercel.app/#/dashboards/<id>
- Source of any dashboard: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/site/dashboards/<id>/index.html, style.css, app.js

## Starter code

- [Starter index.html](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/templates/starter/index.html) · [style.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/templates/starter/style.css) · [app.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/templates/starter/app.js): working multi-page prototype skeleton with search, sort, board, slide-over form and all four data states

## Full framework (careful route, eight phases with gates)

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/framework/00-overview.md) · [Discover](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/framework/01-discover.md) · [Define](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/framework/02-define.md) · [Direction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/framework/03-direction.md) · [Design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/framework/04-design.md) · [Build](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/framework/05-build.md) · [Polish](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/framework/06-polish.md) · [Ship](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/framework/07-ship.md) · [Handover](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SacredRebel/dashboard-tools-/main/docs/framework/08-handover.md)
